requirements.summary: Only the power states of the table appear, and the state changes only along its transitions.
While a domain is isolated its outputs show the value of the table: 0, 1 or the last value.
After power-up a retained register has its value from before; the others have their reset value before use.
B is powered only while A is: B goes down first and comes up last, and a request for B alone powers nothing.
An operand taken in the cycle of a power-down request is kept; later operands are refused until the domain is on again; a started sequence runs to its end.
A global reset turns both domains off and clears the retained values, whether the domains were on or off.
